name: Loglet · Gremlet #26
description:
A log from the woodpile that would rather be a friend than firewood. Still sprouting.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Loglet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
